scope: Primary documentation for the new process revalidation boundary; not native execution evidence.

sources.title: Win32_Process class
sources.facts_used: Process IDs can be reused after termination. CreationDate identifies when the process began. ParentProcessId alone does not establish a continuing parent identity. CommandLine is the process start command where available.
sources.retrieval: Public source checked in this turn; not a local Windows probe.

sources.title: SWbemServices.ExecQuery method
sources.facts_used: ExecQuery returns a collection that must be enumerated. A query can legitimately return an empty result set; query/access/enumeration errors are separate failures. Flags 16 and 32 select return-immediately and forward-only behavior.
sources.retrieval: Public source checked in this turn; not a local WMI execution.

design_inference: A fully completed targeted query can distinguish absence from a still-present unreadable row. A returned process must match the original full creation identity before its refreshed command is used. This is a read-only validation strategy, not an atomic OS process snapshot.
